What is GeM Registration and who needs it? GeM Registration is the process of creating an official account on the Government e-Marketplace. Any business that wants to sell goods or services to Indian government departments, ministries, or PSUs needs it. Is GeM Registration online in India free? Registering on the portal itself is free. GeM doesn't charge a sign-up fee. Some sellers may still need to pay a refundable caution money deposit, and this policy changes periodically, so it's worth confirming your exact requirement at the time you apply. How long does gem portal seller registration take? Once your documents pass verification, you typically get your Seller ID within 24 to 48 business hours. The full process, including document preparation, usually takes a couple of weeks from start to finish. Can a startup or MSME register on GeM without a long business history? Yes. DPIIT-recognised startups and Udyam-registered MSMEs get relaxations on turnover and prior-experience requirements that other sellers don't get. Is Aadhaar mandatory for GeM seller registration? Aadhaar is generally used for OTP verification and to confirm identity, but PAN-based verification is also accepted for sellers in certain cases. It's best to confirm which route applies to your entity type before you begin. Can a reseller or OEM register on GeM? Yes, both can register. You'll need to declare which category you fall under — OEM or reseller — accurately for each product you list, since this affects how your listing is treated. What happens if my GeM registration gets rejected? You'll usually get a reason in the rejection notice. Correct the specific issue, which is often a document mismatch or unclear upload, and then resubmit. Most rejections are fixable quickly once you know what triggered them. What documents are required for GeM seller registration? At a minimum: PAN, Aadhaar of the authorised signatory, GST certificate, bank account proof, and your business registration document (partnership deed, LLP agreement, or Certificate of Incorporation, depending on your entity type). Can foreign companies register on GeM? Yes, provided they meet GeM's documentation requirements and demonstrate a legitimate presence or operations relevant to Indian procurement rules. How do I update my GeM profile after registration? Log in to your GeM dashboard, go to your profile section, and update details like contact information, bank account, or product categories. Some changes may require re-verification. Is caution money the same as a registration fee? No. Registration is free. Caution money is a separate, refundable security deposit tied to your turnover. It's not a cost you permanently lose. What's the difference between buyer and seller registration? Buyer registration is for government department officers who purchase through GeM. Seller registration is for businesses that want to sell goods or services on the platform. Most businesses only need seller registration.

Selling to the government sounds like a headache, doesn't it? Endless paperwork, government offices, and people telling you to "come back next week". That's actually how it used to work. Not anymore.

Today, if you want to sell your products or services to any government department, ministry, or PSU in India, there's one door you need to walk through: the Government e-Marketplace, or GeM. And getting through that door starts with GeM registration.

This page walks you through everything — what GeM registration actually is, who can apply, what it costs, what documents you'll need, and how the whole process works from start to finish. No jargon. No fluff. Just what you need to know.
If you'd rather skip the reading and get someone to handle it for you, our GeM Registration service does exactly that, from your first document upload to the day you get your seller ID.
GeM stands for Government e-Marketplace. Think of it as an online shopping platform, except the buyers are government departments, and the sellers are businesses like yours.

The portal was launched in August 2016 by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Before GeM existed, government purchases went through a slow, paper-heavy tendering system. Officers filed requests, vendors submitted physical bids, and the whole thing could take months. GeM changed that by moving procurement online: searchable, comparable, and (mostly) fast.

Here's the part most people don't realise: GeM isn't a small experiment anymore. It has grown into one of the largest public procurement platforms in the world, second only to South Korea's KONEPS system. Lakhs of sellers, from one-person proprietorships to large manufacturers, already operate on it.

GeM Registration is simply the process of setting up your official account, as a seller or a buyer, on this portal. Without it, you can't list a single product or place a single government order. With it, you're standing in the same marketplace as every ministry and PSU in the country.

This is for government offices, not private businesses. A government department that wants to purchase goods or services through GeM needs to register its officers as buyers. There are three buyer roles on the portal:
Primary User (HOD) — The head of the department or office
Verifying Authority (VA) — The person who approves purchases
Primary User (Cooperative) — Used by cooperative societies that also buy through GeM
Buyer registration requires a government email ID, the officer's Aadhaar number, and department details like address and landline number.

What is GeM Registration and who needs it?

GeM Registration is the process of creating an official account on the Government e-Marketplace. Any business that wants to sell goods or services to Indian government departments, ministries, or PSUs needs it.
Is GeM Registration online in India free?

Registering on the portal itself is free. GeM doesn't charge a sign-up fee. Some sellers may still need to pay a refundable caution money deposit, and this policy changes periodically, so it's worth confirming your exact requirement at the time you apply.
How long does gem portal seller registration take?

Once your documents pass verification, you typically get your Seller ID within 24 to 48 business hours. The full process, including document preparation, usually takes a couple of weeks from start to finish.
Can a startup or MSME register on GeM without a long business history?
Yes. DPIIT-recognised startups and Udyam-registered MSMEs get relaxations on turnover and prior-experience requirements that other sellers don't get.
Is Aadhaar mandatory for GeM seller registration?

Aadhaar is generally used for OTP verification and to confirm identity, but PAN-based verification is also accepted for sellers in certain cases. It's best to confirm which route applies to your entity type before you begin.
Can a reseller or OEM register on GeM?
Yes, both can register. You'll need to declare which category you fall under — OEM or reseller — accurately for each product you list, since this affects how your listing is treated.
What happens if my GeM registration gets rejected?

You'll usually get a reason in the rejection notice. Correct the specific issue, which is often a document mismatch or unclear upload, and then resubmit. Most rejections are fixable quickly once you know what triggered them.
